title: Documentation
body: Everything you need to set up, configure, and integrate with the store. Start with Getting Started, or jump straight to the API reference.

title: Getting Started
body: This section covers installation and first configuration. If you only read one page, read Installation.

title: Installation
body: Install the client library, add your API key to the environment, and make a first request against the products endpoint to confirm connectivity.

title: Configuration
body: Configuration is read from environment variables at startup. Values set at runtime are ignored, which is deliberate: it keeps the running process reproducible.

title: Deployment
body: Build the application, run the migration step, then promote. The migration is idempotent and safe to run against an already-current database.

title: Authentication
body: Sessions are carried in an httpOnly cookie. Tokens are signed, not encrypted, so never place anything sensitive in the payload.

title: Products API
body: List, read, create, update, and delete products. List responses are paginated and include total and totalPages alongside the items array.

title: Users API
body: Read and create users. Role is assigned server-side and cannot be set through the public create endpoint.
